prompt.text: Generate a highly detailed vertical cutaway illustration of a fictional two-stage launch vehicle named Aster-9 on a clean white technical background. Show the full rocket from nose cone to engines, sliced to reveal internal tanks, avionics, payload fairing, interstage, turbopumps, and thrust structure. Use a restrained palette of white, gunmetal, orange, pale blue, and safety red accents. Add precise leader lines and crisp labels. Include in-image text: "ASTER-9", "Payload 8,400 kg", "Height 62.4 m", "Stage 1 RP-1 / LOX", and "Stage 2 Methalox". Label internal parts such as "Payload Bay", "Guidance Computer", "LOX Tank", "Fuel Tank", "Helium COPV", and "Engine Cluster x9". Add a small scale marker with "0 m", "20 m", "40 m", and "60 m". Prioritize accurate engineering-diagram composition, clean typography, believable hardware detail, and razor-sharp annotations optimized for gpt-image-2.
